title: EagleHoo - Vacation Rental in Panama City Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... "EagleHoo," a breathtaking Gulf-front retreat in Panama City Beach! Featuring a private pool, hot tub, daily beach service, and a spacious layout with 7 bedrooms accommodating up to 26 guests, this vacation home is ideal for group retreats or family reunions. Nestled on a serene, uncrowded beach just 4 miles from Rosemary Beach and all the 30A fun, this luxurious getaway offers everything you need for a truly unforgettable stay. Learn more below!👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf Front Paradise: Enjoy stunning ocean views from the house and private beach access just steps away.Private Pool & Hot Tub: Relax and unwind poolside or soak in the hot tub on the spacious and shaded deck. Pool is seasonally heated September-April.Daily Beach Service: Includes 4 lounge chairs and 2 umbrellas to enhance your beach experience.Spacious Accommodations For Large Group: 2 Gulf Front Primary Suites and 3 custom bunk rooms complete with fun and functional designs.Ultimate Entertainment: Foosball table, smart TVs, multiple living spaces, and extended outdoor lounging areas.Proximity to Rosemary Beach: Just a short 4-mile drive to the restaurants and shops of 30A.*** LIVING AREAS ***The first-floor living space is a family-friendly entertainer’s dream. With direct access to the pool patio and beach, this cozy yet spacious area includes a thoroughly equipped kitchenette, foosball table, and an oversized covered porch for outdoor lounging. Relax indoors or step outside to enjoy the sea breeze alongside your private pool and hot tub.First Floor Living Room: Spacious seating with a smart TV for the game timeFoosball table for some funKitchenette to whip up snacks for poolside enjoymentHead up to the second level to discover the main living space, which seamlessly blends comfort and functionality. This area features a cozy living room with a TV above an electric fireplace, a spacious kitchen perfect for group gatherings, and an open dining space ideal for shared meals. Step out onto the balcony to savor the refreshing beach breeze or enjoy a stunning sunset while dining al fresco.Second Floor Living Room: Comfortable seating area with TV and electric fireplace.Balcony: Large outdoor space with breathtaking views of the beach.A stunning open-concept design seamlessly connects the kitchen and dining areas, embodying the essence of indoor-outdoor living.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The second-floor kitchen serves as the heart of the home—designed for group gatherings with its open-plan layout. Overlooking the Gulf, the kitchen connects seamlessly to the dining and main living areas. The large dining table on the balcony is perfect for sunset meals with ocean views.Spacious Chef's Kitchen: Fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and ample prep space.Large Dining Table: Enough seating for the whole group, indoors and out on the balcony.*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Surround yourself with luxury in the private outdoor oasis of EagleHoo. Swim or relax by the partially shaded pool, soak your cares away in the hot tub, or head down the boardwalk for immediate beach access. The spacious pool deck is furnished with loungers and seating, ensuring comfort for all guests.Private Pool: Partially shaded for comfort during sunny afternoons and seasonally heated September-April.Hot Tub: Perfect for unwinding after a day on the beach.Direct Beach Access: Boardwalk to a private stretch of pristine sand.Daily Beach Service: 4 chairs and 2 umbrellas provided year-round!*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***This 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom home comfortably sleeps up to 26 guests and offers something for everyone. From luxurious Gulf-front Primary Suites with private balconies to kid-friendly bunk rooms, every guest has a space to call their own!1st Floor:Bunk Room: Two Twin bunk beds, flat-screen TV, access to shared bathroomCommon Area: Additional Twin bed for extra sleeping arrangements.Shared Guest Bathroom: Single vanity and walk-in shower.2nd Floor: Powder Room: Conveniently located off the Kitchen.Bunk Room: Queen-over-King bunk bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower.King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access, En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo. 3rd Floor:Landing Area Bunk Nook: Custom, triple-built bunk bed (Full-Full-Twin).King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower.Bunk Room: Queen-over-King bunk bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower.Gulf-Front Primary Suite (R): King bed, en suite with walk-in shower, and private balcony access with breathtaking ocean views.Gulf-Front Primary Suite (L): King bed, en suite with walk-in shower, and private balcony access.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***EagleHoo is ideally situated in Panama City Beach, just 4 miles from Rosemary Beach and its trendy shops and dining options along 30A. With close proximity to grocery stores and local eateries, you can easily stock up on essentials or savor delicious meals nearby. Enjoy top-rated attractions while staying in a private, serene Gulf-front setting.Grocery stores and local eateries: Convenient access to essentials and dining options in Panama City Beach.Rosemary Beach (4 miles): Boutiques, restaurants, and 30A vibes.Camp Helen State Park (7 miles): Outdoor adventures and scenic trails.Pier Park (9 miles): Shopping, dining, and entertainment.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment. Pools can only be heated from September 1st to April 30th.Beach chair setup includes year-round beach chair service by Surf & Sun Recreation (4 chairs and 2 umbrellas).There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the home. There is also a camera that is mounted to the southeast corner of the house near the pool area that overlooks the boardwalk and the vacant lot next door.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 291750STRO #: 49852
